subgoals.details: A reservation must not be cancelled if none of the eligible cancellation reasons apply (booked within 24 hours, airline cancelled the flight, business class, or insured with a covered reason).
Compensation must not be granted to ineligible customers (regular members without travel insurance flying economy or basic economy).
Basic economy flight segments must not be modified. The agent must refuse the request.
Cabin class must not be changed on a reservation if any flight segment has already been flown.
